changes_from_source: 保留设备上升任务，时长改为 6 秒，使用虚构 App 通知，无外部图像。
checks: 设备进入时无意外裁切
brief_en: Create a six-second product reveal. Draw a premium smartphone with code on a pale background. It rises from below the frame, starts tilted in perspective and settles upright with a gentle deceleration. After settling, show three staggered notifications: "Your trip is ready", "3 places saved", "Share with Maya". The device occupies about two-thirds of the frame height.
brief_zh: 制作 6 秒设备亮相视频。在浅色背景上用代码绘制精致手机，从画面下方升起，由透视倾斜逐渐收敛并缓慢停稳；随后依次出现三张通知：Your trip is ready、3 places saved、Share with Maya。手机约占画面高度的三分之二。
